title: The War of the Gods
lines: Jiang Ziya, an immortal sage who had spent decades fishing with a straight hook, was summoned to lead the rebellion against Shang. From Kunlun Mountain, armies of immortals descended. Each side had its champions — gods, demons, and divine beasts.

Nezha, born from a flesh ball after a three-year pregnancy, wielded the Universe Ring and the Red Armillary Sash. Yang Jian opened his third eye, which could see through all illusions. Thunder God struck from the clouds. Earth God split the ground.

Battles raged across China. Each fallen immortal was not truly destroyed — they were 'invested' with a divine post in the celestial bureaucracy, hence the name: Fengshen Yanyi, the Investiture of the Gods.

At last, King Zhou's capital fell. Da Ji's true form was revealed. The fox spirit was executed, and Zhou burned himself in his palace. The Zhou Dynasty began, and Jiang Ziya became the greatest strategist-god of Chinese mythology.
